newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers stable despite crude losses.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers stable despite crude losses.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Wednesday were little changed from Tuesday as sellers were reluctant to lower their offers , traders said.
They said despite crude losses, bunker quotes were holding steady as some sellers expected prices to gain strength later this week.
Majors were quoting 180-cst at $125-$128 per tonne and 380-cst at $121-$122. Independents were at $125-$126 per tonne for 180 cst and at $119-$122 for 380-cst.
MDO prices also were also stable at $223-228 and gas oil were lower at $234-$238. -- Singapore newsroom (+65-870-3082)
